description: Verify that echoUTF16DYNAMIC two-step length-too-short — DUT echoes valid first then rejects truncated
approach:
[Objective]
Mixed-correctness sequence: a valid Request must be echoed; a follow-up with a too-short length must be rejected — proves DUT's validation is per-message, not session-level.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT → Tester: OfferService.
2. Tester → DUT: valid echoUTF16DYNAMIC Request → DUT must echo.
3. Tester → DUT: same method but with length-too-short payload → DUT must reject.

[Pass condition]
Observed DUT behaviour matches the spec property.

[Fail condition]
Per-phase Fail_phase<n>_* per the verdict list.

verdicts.Pass: DUT echoed valid then rejected truncated — normal
verdicts.Fail_phase2_no_valid_echo: DUT did not echo valid first request
verdicts.Fail_phase3_dut_accepted_malformed: DUT returned OK Response for truncated inner string
